note: Popularity figures are GitHub stars read from the repository pages on the check date; they are a signal, not a safety proof. Install counts per plugin were not verified. Nothing here is installed by the template. Every install needs a proposal, a security read of the manifest/prompts/hooks/MCP commands, explicit user approval and a registry row.

marketplaces.caveat: Anthropic states it does not control what MCP servers, files or software a plugin contains; review before installing.

plugins.name: superpowers

plugins.name: claude-code-setup
serves: principal: recommends hooks, subagents and MCP for a codebase

plugins.name: github
serves: GitHub Projects and issues access; prefer gh CLI when available; needs a token, grant the narrowest scopes

plugins.name: marketing

plugins.name: product-management

plugins.name: data

plugins.name: legal
